name: [🚀] 67 TAG!
desc:
Welcome to 67 Tag! 🔥
Run and jump your way through 7 maps! — but watch out! If you get tagged, you turn into Red 67! Chase down others before time runs out!

💰 Earn Coins by playing, tagging, and surviving!
🧢 Buy Cool Cosmetics to show off your style!
👍 Thumbs Up & Favourite for more updates, maps, and items!

Can you become the fastest 67 in the game? 🌴🔥
